name: Mirugeki 1: Imouto -Boku to Asumi no Himitsu Taiken-
original_name: みるげき1 妹 -僕とあすみの秘密体験-
source:
Main character's cousin Shunsuke has very close relations with his sister. When protagonist gets invited to cousin's birthday party, he witnesses incest relations there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的表亲俊介与妹妹关系非常亲密。当主人公受邀参加表亲的生日聚会时，目睹了那里的乱伦关系。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]）
